verses.sloka: स निर्जत्य पुरीम् लण्का श्रेष्ठाम् ताम् कामरूपिणीम् ।विक्रमेण महातेजा हनुमान् कपिसत्तमः ॥५-४-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa nirjatya purīm laṇkā śreṣṭhām tām kāmarūpiṇīm ।vikrameṇa mahātejā hanumān kapisattamaḥ ॥5-4-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the strongshouldered, mighty monkey chief having defeated the (presiding) deity of Lanka who could assume any form at her will, leaped over the boundary wall of the rear entrance of the excellent city by his prowess.
translations.hindi: महाबली, महाबाहू, महातेजस्वी, वानरश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी ने, लंकापुरी कामरूपिणी ्रधिष्ठात्री देवी को भ्रपने पराक्रम से जीत कर, द्वार सेन जा कर किन्तु कूद कर, परकोटे की दीवाल फाँदी और लंका में प्रवेश किया

verses.sloka: अद्वारेण मःआतेजा हौमान् कपिसत्तमः ।प्रविश्य नगरीम् लङ्काम् कपिराजहितम्करः ॥५-४-२॥
verses.transliteration: advāreṇa maḥātejā haumān kapisattamaḥ ।praviśya nagarīm laṅkām kapirājahitamkaraḥ ॥5-4-2॥

translations.english: Hanuman, a devotee of the king of monkeys entered the city of Lanka placing his left foot first on the forehead of the city and proceeded (by tradition one enters the enemy's dwelling by placing the left foot first to cause defeat of the enemy).

verses.sloka: चक्रेणाऽथ पदम् सव्यम् शत्रूणाम् स तु मूर्धनि ।प्रविष्टः सत्त्वसंपन्नो विशायाम् मारुतात्मजः ॥५-४-३॥
verses.transliteration: cakreṇā'tha padam savyam śatrūṇām sa tu mūrdhani ।praviṣṭaḥ sattvasaṁpanno viśāyām mārutātmajaḥ ॥5-4-3॥

translations.english: The son of the Windgod, endowed with great strength, entered the enchanting Lanka and walked along the highway set with flowers of pearls.
translations.hindi: ।। [ टिप्पणो--द्वार से भ्रर्थात्‌ फाटक से हनुमानजी नहीं गए । इसका एक कारण तो यह था कि उन्होंने पहरुए राक्षसों की निगाह बचाई दूसरे शास्त्र की भ्राज्ञा भी है--कि विशेष समयों पर दूसरे राज के ग्रामक श्रथवा नगर में फाटक से प्रवेश न करे। यथा-- ग्रामं वा नगरं वापि पत्तन वा परस्य हि। विशेषात्समये सौम्य न द्वारेणविशेन्नूप ॥।] प्रविश्य नगरीं लंकां कपिराजहितंकरः । चक्रेऽथ पादं सव्यं च शत्रूणां स तु मूर्धनि

verses.sloka: स महापथमास्थाय मुक्तापुष्पविराजितम् ।ततस्तु ताम् पुरीम् लङ्काम् रम्यामभिययौ कपिः ॥५-४-४॥
verses.transliteration: sa mahāpathamāsthāya muktāpuṣpavirājitam ।tatastu tām purīm laṅkām ramyāmabhiyayau kapiḥ ॥5-4-4॥

translations.english: The son of the Windgod, endowed with great strength, entered the enchanting Lanka and walked along the highway set with flowers of pearls.
translations.hindi: नोट--कहाँ-कहां प्रथम वाम पैर रखना चाहिए ? यह बात्त बृहस्पति जी ने बतलाई है । यथा-- [ प्रयाणकाले च गृहप्रवेशे विवाहकालेऽपि च दक्षिणाङ्ध्िम्‌ । कृत्वाग्रतः णत्रुपुरप्रवेशे वामं निदध्याच्चरणं नुपालः ॥। अर्थात्‌ राजा को उचित है कि यात्रा के समय, गृह-प्रवेश करते समय, विवाह-काल में तो दाहिने पैर से आगे बढे;' किन्तु शत्रु के नगर में प्रवेश करते समय प्रथम वाम चरण भ्रागे रखे । ] प्रविष्टः सत्वसम्पन्नो निशायां मारुतात्मजः । स॒ महापथमास्थाय मुक्तापुष्पविराजितम्‌

verses.sloka: हसित उद्घुष्ट निनदैः तूर्य घोष पुरः सरैः  ।वज्र अन्कुश निकाशैः च वज्र जाल विभूषितैः ॥५-४-५॥
verses.transliteration: hasita udghuṣṭa ninadaiḥ tūrya ghoṣa puraḥ saraiḥ  ।vajra ankuśa nikāśaiḥ ca vajra jāla vibhūṣitaiḥ ॥5-4-5॥

translations.english: The houses reverberating with sounds of laughter and of musical instruments, decorated with lattice windows of diamonds resembled the sky shining with clouds with a goad made of diamond (thunderbolt of Indra).
translations.hindi: रमणीक लंकापुरी में जाते समय, हनुमानजी ने लोगों के हँसने का तथा नगाड़ों के बजने का शब्द सुना

verses.sloka: गृह मेधैः  पुरी रम्या बभासे द्यौः इव अम्बुदैः ।प्रजज्वाल तदा लन्का रक्षः गण गृहैः  शुभैः ॥५-४-६॥
verses.transliteration: gṛha medhaiḥ  purī ramyā babhāse dyauḥ iva ambudaiḥ ।prajajvāla tadā lankā rakṣaḥ gaṇa gṛhaiḥ  śubhaiḥ ॥5-4-6॥

translations.english: The city of Lanka appeared radiant with its tall mansions resembling white clouds. The mansions had auspicious marks of lotus and swastika engraved on them and were opening in the direction of the south.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने लंका में भ्रनेक प्रकार के घर देखे । उन घरों में .कोई तो वज्र के श्राकार का, कोई अंकुश के श्राकार का बना हुआ था । उनमें हीरे के जडाव के झरोखे वने हुए थे । उन प्रधान-प्रधान घरों से उस रमणीक पुरी की ऐसी शोभा हो रही थी, जैसी शोभा मेघों से ग्राकाश की हुआ करती है

verses.sloka: सित अभ्र सदृशैः चित्रैः  पद्म स्वस्तिक सम्स्थितैः ।वर्धमान गृहैः च अपि सर्वतः सुविभाषितैः ॥५-४-७॥
verses.transliteration: sita abhra sadṛśaiḥ citraiḥ  padma svastika samsthitaiḥ ।vardhamāna gṛhaiḥ ca api sarvataḥ suvibhāṣitaiḥ ॥5-4-7॥

translations.english: The city of Lanka appeared radiant with its tall mansions resembling white clouds. The mansions had auspicious marks of lotus and swastika engraved on them and were opening in the direction of the south.
translations.hindi: राक्षसों के सुन्दर गृहों से उस काल लंकापुरी खूब दमक रही थी । उन इवेत एवं विशाल भवनों में से किसी की बनावट कमलाकार, किसी की स्वस्तिकाकार थी

verses.sloka: ताम् चित्र माल्य आभरणाम् कपि राज हितम् करः ।राघव अर्थम् चरन् श्रीमान् ददर्श च ननन्द च ॥५-४-८॥
verses.transliteration: tām citra mālya ābharaṇām kapi rāja hitam karaḥ ।rāghava artham caran śrīmān dadarśa ca nananda ca ॥5-4-8॥

translations.english: Glorious Hanuman, wellwisher of Sugriva, king of vanaras, looked around the city, decorated with colourful garlands. Surveying it for the cause of Raghava, he was greatly delighted.
translations.hindi: टं सुम्दर [मोड--बराहुमिहिर संहिता छे पद्माकार स्वस्विकाकार भादि गुहो के शक्षण दिए हुए हे। विस्तारभय से उनका उल्लेख यहाँ नहीं किया बघा । ] वर्धमानगृहेश्वापि सर्वतः सुविभूषिता। तां चित्रमाल्याभरणां कपिराजहितङ्करः

verses.sloka: भवनाद्भवनं गच्छ्न् ददर्श पवनात्मजः ।विविधाकृतिरूपाणि भवनानि ततस्ततः ॥५-४-९॥
verses.transliteration: bhavanādbhavanaṁ gacchn dadarśa pavanātmajaḥ ।vividhākṛtirūpāṇi bhavanāni tatastataḥ ॥5-4-9॥

translations.english: Going from one building to another, Hanuman saw mansions of different kinds structures.

verses.sloka: शुश्राव मधुरम् गीतम् त्रि स्थान स्वर भूषितम् ।स्त्रीणाम् मद समृद्धानाम् दिवि च अप्सरसाम् इव ॥५-४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: śuśrāva madhuram gītam tri sthāna svara bhūṣitam ।strīṇām mada samṛddhānām divi ca apsarasām iva ॥5-4-10॥

translations.english: He heard melodious songs of intoxicated women set to tune in three places namely chest, throat and head and three pitches known as mandra (slow) madhya (medium) and tara (high). The songs resembled those of the apsarasas well set in musical notes set to music.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र का कार्य पूरा करने के लिए, हनुमानजी लंकापुरी को देख प्रसन्न होते थे प्रौर जानकीजी को खोजने के लिए एक घर से दूसरे घर में जाते हुए, विविध भ्राकार के घरों को देखते थे । उन भवनों मे सुन्दर याने का शब्द सुन पड़ता था । वह गान वक्षःस्थल, कंठ श्रौर मस्तक से निकले हुए मन्दर, मध्य भ्रौर तार नामक स्वरों से युक्त था ।। €

verses.sloka: शुश्राव कान्ची निनदम् नूपुराणाम् च निह्स्वनम् ।सोपान निनदामः चैव भवनेषु महात्मनम् ॥५-४-११॥
verses.transliteration: śuśrāva kāncī ninadam nūpurāṇām ca nihsvanam ।sopāna ninadāmaḥ caiva bhavaneṣu mahātmanam ॥5-4-11॥

translations.english: Great Hanuman heard the jingling sounds of waist bells and anklets of women and sounds of great men climbing up and down flights of steps, sounds of clapping and joking everywhere in the mansions.
translations.hindi: स्वगेवासिनी अप्सराझों को तरह काम से उन्मत्त हुई स्त्रियों के बिछुवे सौर करधनी की झनकार, जो स्त्रियों के सीढ़ियों पर चढ़ने-उतरने से होती थी--हनुमानजी वहाँ के बलवान्‌ राक्षसों के घरों में सुनते जाते थे । कहीं- १ पाठान्तरे--“मद समृद्धानां ।” | कहीं तालियां बजाने भौर सिहतुल्य दहाड़ने के शब्द भी सुन पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: आस्फोटित निनादामः च क्ष्वेडितामः च ततः ततः ।शुश्राव जपताम् तत्र मन्त्रन् रक्षोगृहेषु वै ॥५-४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: āsphoṭita ninādāmaḥ ca kṣveḍitāmaḥ ca tataḥ tataḥ ।śuśrāva japatām tatra mantran rakṣogṛheṣu vai ॥5-4-12॥

translations.english: He heard chantings of sacred verses in the houses of demons engaged in the study of the vedas. And heard demons singing loudly the eulogy of Ravana.

verses.sloka: स्वाध्याय निरतामः चैव यातु धानान् ददर्श सः ।रावण स्तव सम्युक्तान् गर्जतः राक्षसान् अपि ॥५-४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: svādhyāya niratāmaḥ caiva yātu dhānān dadarśa saḥ ।rāvaṇa stava samyuktān garjataḥ rākṣasān api ॥5-4-13॥

translations.english: He heard chantings of sacred verses in the houses of demons engaged in the study of the vedas. And heard demons singing loudly the eulogy of Ravana.
translations.hindi: हनुमान जी ने राक्षसों के भवनों में जप करने वाले राक्षसों द्वारा उच्चारित मन्त्रों को सुता ग्रौर स्वाध्यायनिरत राक्षसों को देखा

verses.sloka: राज मार्गम् समावृत्य स्थितम् रक्षः बलम् महत् ।ददर्श मध्यमे गुल्मे राक्षसस्य चरान् बहून् ॥५-४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: rāja mārgam samāvṛtya sthitam rakṣaḥ balam mahat ।dadarśa madhyame gulme rākṣasasya carān bahūn ॥5-4-14॥

translations.english: He observed large contingents of demons lining the highway and spies of Ravana stationed in the middle of the city.
translations.hindi: झनेक राक्षसों को रावण की प्रशंसा करते और गर्जते हुए देखा । राज- मागं को घेरे हुए राक्षसों का एक बड़ा दल खडा हुम्ला था

verses.sloka: दीक्षितान् जटिलान् मुण्डान् गः अजिन अम्बर वाससः ।दर्भ मुष्टि प्रहरणान् अग्नि कुण्ड आयुधामः तथा ॥५-४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: dīkṣitān jaṭilān muṇḍān gaḥ ajina ambara vāsasaḥ ।darbha muṣṭi praharaṇān agni kuṇḍa āyudhāmaḥ tathā ॥5-4-15॥

translations.english: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.
translations.hindi: नगर के बीच में सैनिकों की जो छावनी थी, उपरमे हनुमानजी ने अनेक जासूसों को देखा । इनके अतिरिक्त वहाँ पर बहुत से गृहस्थ जटाधारी, मुडिया, बैल का चमड़ा बस्त्र की तरह श्रोढ़े हुए,

verses.sloka: कूट मुद्गर पाणीमः च दण्ड आयुध धरान् अपि ।एक अक्ष अनेक कर्णामः च चलल् लम्ब पयः धरान् ॥५-४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: kūṭa mudgara pāṇīmaḥ ca daṇḍa āyudha dharān api ।eka akṣa aneka karṇāmaḥ ca calal lamba payaḥ dharān ॥5-4-16॥

translations.english: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.
translations.hindi: कुश के मूठे से प्रहार करने वाले, मन्तों द्वारा भ्रग्नि से कृत्या उत्पन्न करने वाले, केटीले मुग्‌दर धारण करने वाले, डंडा-घारी,

verses.sloka: करालान् भुग्न वक्त्रामः च विकटान् वामनामः तथा ।धन्विनः खड्गिनः चैव शतघ्नी मुसल आयुधान् ॥५-४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: karālān bhugna vaktrāmaḥ ca vikaṭān vāmanāmaḥ tathā ।dhanvinaḥ khaḍginaḥ caiva śataghnī musala āyudhān ॥5-4-17॥

translations.english: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.
translations.hindi: एक आँख वाले, अनेक कानों वाले, छाती पर लम्त्रे लटकते हुए स्तनों वाले, देखने में भयंकर, टेढ़े मुख वाले, विकट रूप घारी, बौतें

verses.sloka: परिघ उत्तम हस्तामः च विचित्र कवच उज्ज्वलान् ।नातिस्थूलान् नातिकृशान् नातिदीर्घ अतिह्रस्वकान् ॥५-४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: parigha uttama hastāmaḥ ca vicitra kavaca ujjvalān ।nātisthūlān nātikṛśān nātidīrgha atihrasvakān ॥5-4-18॥

translations.english: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.
translations.hindi: घनुषधारी, खञ्गघारी, शतघ्नी और मूसलधारी, परिघ को हाथ में लिये हुए और विचित्र चमकते हुए कवच पहिने हुए राक्षसों को हनुमानजी ने देखा

verses.sloka: नातिगौरान्नातिकृष्णान्नातिकुब्जान्न वामनान् ।विरूपान् बहु रूपामः च सुरूपामः च सुवर्चसः ॥५-४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: nātigaurānnātikṛṣṇānnātikubjānna vāmanān ।virūpān bahu rūpāmaḥ ca surūpāmaḥ ca suvarcasaḥ ॥5-4-19॥

translations.english: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.

verses.sloka: ध्वजीन् पताकिनश्चैव ददर्श विविधायुधान् ।शक्ति वृक्ष आयुधामः चैव पट्टिश अशनि धारिणः ॥५-४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: dhvajīn patākinaścaiva dadarśa vividhāyudhān ।śakti vṛkṣa āyudhāmaḥ caiva paṭṭiśa aśani dhāriṇaḥ ॥5-4-20॥

translations.english: The great monkey saw the demons who held shaktis and trees as weapons (Shakti is a lance), some held threepointed spears, missiles and slings with which missiles are hurled. Some of them wore flower garlands, smeared unguents on their body and were bedecked with choicest ornaments. They were dressed in several ways and many of them moved freely. They were very strong and held sharp tridents and armed with thunderboltlike weapons.
translations.hindi: कुरूप भी थे, श्रनेक रूपधारी थे, सुन्दर थे और तेजस्वी भी थे । कहीं-कहीं ष्वजाधारी, पताकाधारी और अनेक आयुधों को धारण करने वाले सैनिक सक्षस भी थे

verses.sloka: क्षेपणी पाश हस्तामः च ददर्श स महा कपिः ।स्रग्विणः त्व् अनुलिप्तामः च वर आभरण भूषितान् ॥५-४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: kṣepaṇī pāśa hastāmaḥ ca dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ ।sragviṇaḥ tv anuliptāmaḥ ca vara ābharaṇa bhūṣitān ॥5-4-21॥

translations.english: The great monkey saw the demons who held shaktis and trees as weapons (Shakti is a lance), some held threepointed spears, missiles and slings with which missiles are hurled. Some of them wore flower garlands, smeared unguents on their body and were bedecked with choicest ornaments. They were dressed in several ways and many of them moved freely. They were very strong and held sharp tridents and armed with thunderboltlike weapons.
translations.hindi: उनमें अनेक ऐसे राक्षसों को हनुमान जी ने देखा जो शक्ति, वृक्ष, पटा, वज्ज, गुलेल ग्रौर पाश घारण किए हुए थे

verses.sloka: नानावेषसमायुक्तान्यथास्वैरगतान् बहून् ।तीक्ष्ण शूल धरामः चैव वज्रिणः च महा बलान् ॥५-४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: nānāveṣasamāyuktānyathāsvairagatān bahūn ।tīkṣṇa śūla dharāmaḥ caiva vajriṇaḥ ca mahā balān ॥5-4-22॥

translations.english: The great monkey saw the demons who held shaktis and trees as weapons (Shakti is a lance), some held threepointed spears, missiles and slings with which missiles are hurled. Some of them wore flower garlands, smeared unguents on their body and were bedecked with choicest ornaments. They were dressed in several ways and many of them moved freely. They were very strong and held sharp tridents and armed with thunderboltlike weapons.
translations.hindi: सब राक्षस माला घारण किए हुए, चंदन लगाए हुए और बढ़िया गहने झौर वस्त्र पहिने हुए थे । अनेक प्रकार के अलंकारों को धारण किए हुए फैशन धारी राक्षसों को स्वतन्त्र विहार करते हुए ( हनुमानजी ने देखा )

verses.sloka: शत साहस्रम् अव्यग्रम् आरक्षम् मध्यमम् कपिः ।रक्षोधिपतिनिर्दिष्टम् ददर्शान्तःपुराग्रतः ॥५-४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: śata sāhasram avyagram ārakṣam madhyamam kapiḥ ।rakṣodhipatinirdiṣṭam dadarśāntaḥpurāgrataḥ ॥5-4-23॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw in front of the harem one hundred thousand strong, vigilant soldiers of a middle rank ordered by the lord of demons.
translations.hindi: लंका के मध्य भाग में एक लाख बलवान आर सावधान राक्षस सैनिकों को, हाथों में पैने शूल श्रौर वख लिए हुए, हनुमानजी ने देखा

verses.sloka: स तदा तद्गृहम् दृष्ट्वा महाहाटकतोरणम् ।राक्षसेन्द्रस्य विख्यातमद्रिमूर्ध्नि प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥५-४-२४॥
verses.transliteration: sa tadā tadgṛham dṛṣṭvā mahāhāṭakatoraṇam ।rākṣasendrasya vikhyātamadrimūrdhni pratiṣṭhitam ॥5-4-24॥

translations.english: The great monkey observed the huge archway of the demon king's palace made of gold situated on top of the mountain as if scraping the sky, circled by moats full of white lotuses appearing as though the moats were decorated with earornaments. The whole city was encircled by a boundary wall.
translations.hindi: फिर जब हनुमानजी रावण के रनवास में पहुँचे, तब वहाँ देखा कि रावण की श्राज्ञा से, रनवास के सामने भी राक्षस सैनिकों का पहरा हैँ । तदनन्तर हनुमानजी ने पर्वेत के शिखर पर स्थित रावण का प्रसिद्ध भवन देखा । इस भवन का तोरण द्वार सुवर्ण का बना हुआ था और इस भवन के चारों प्रोर जल से भरी ग्रौर कमलों से शोभित खाइयाँ थीं

verses.sloka: पुण्डरीकावतम्साभिः परिखाभिरलम्कृतम् ।प्राकार आवृतम् अत्यन्तम् ददर्श स महा कपिः ॥५-४-२५॥
verses.transliteration: puṇḍarīkāvatamsābhiḥ parikhābhiralamkṛtam ।prākāra āvṛtam atyantam dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ ॥5-4-25॥

translations.english: The great monkey observed the huge archway of the demon king's palace made of gold situated on top of the mountain as if scraping the sky, circled by moats full of white lotuses appearing as though the moats were decorated with earornaments. The whole city was encircled by a boundary wall.
translations.hindi: भवन के द्वार की शोभा बढ़ाने के लिए सफेद बादल जैसे चार दाँतों वाले बड़े डीलडोल के सफेद हाथी और प्रनेक प्रकार के मत्त मृग ्रौर पक्षी भी थे

verses.sloka: त्रिविष्टप निभम् दिव्यम् दिव्य नाद विनादितम् ।वाजि हेषित सम्घुष्टम् नादितम् भूषणैः तथा ॥५-४-२६॥
verses.transliteration: triviṣṭapa nibham divyam divya nāda vināditam ।vāji heṣita samghuṣṭam nāditam bhūṣaṇaiḥ tathā ॥5-4-26॥

translations.english: And then the great vanara entered the wonderful mansion that resembled heaven. It was resonating with pleasing sounds of jingling ornaments made more noisy by the neighing of the horses. There were carriages, chariots, flying chariots, horses and elephants. The beautiful entrance was looking splendid with intoxicated animals and birds. That place looked splendid with fourtusked elephants resembling heaps of white clouds. The beautiful entrance was guarded by thousands of valiant demons.
translations.hindi: खाई के बाद एक बड़ा ऊंचा परकोटा था । हनुमानजी ने रावण के भवन को स्वगे की तरह सुन्दर पाया । उस भवन में स्वर्गीय गाना-बजाना हो रहा था

verses.sloka: रथैः यानैः विमानैः च तथा गज हयैः  शुभैः  ।वारणैः च चतुः दन्तैः  श्वेत अभ्र निचय उपमैः  ॥५-४-२७॥
verses.transliteration: rathaiḥ yānaiḥ vimānaiḥ ca tathā gaja hayaiḥ  śubhaiḥ  ।vāraṇaiḥ ca catuḥ dantaiḥ  śveta abhra nicaya upamaiḥ  ॥5-4-27॥

translations.english: And then the great vanara entered the wonderful mansion that resembled heaven. It was resonating with pleasing sounds of jingling ornaments made more noisy by the neighing of the horses. There were carriages, chariots, flying chariots, horses and elephants. The beautiful entrance was looking splendid with intoxicated animals and birds. That place looked splendid with fourtusked elephants resembling heaps of white clouds. The beautiful entrance was guarded by thousands of valiant demons.
translations.hindi: भवन के द्वार पर घोड़े हिनहिना रहे थे, भ्रोर वे जो आभूषण धारण किए हुए थे, उनकी झनकार भी हो रही थी । इनके ग्रतिरिक्त विविध प्रकार के रथ प्रादि सवारियाँ, विमान आर अच्छी नस्ल के हाथी श्रोर घोड़े भी मौजूद थे

verses.sloka: भूषितम् रुचिर द्वारम् मत्तैः च मृग पक्षिभिः ।राक्षस अधिपतेः गुप्तम् आविवेश गृहम् कपिः ॥५-४-२८॥
verses.transliteration: bhūṣitam rucira dvāram mattaiḥ ca mṛga pakṣibhiḥ ।rākṣasa adhipateḥ guptam āviveśa gṛham kapiḥ ॥5-4-28॥

translations.english: And then the great vanara entered the wonderful mansion that resembled heaven. It was resonating with pleasing sounds of jingling ornaments made more noisy by the neighing of the horses. There were carriages, chariots, flying chariots, horses and elephants. The beautiful entrance was looking splendid with intoxicated animals and birds. That place looked splendid with fourtusked elephants resembling heaps of white clouds. The beautiful entrance was guarded by thousands of valiant demons.

verses.sloka: सहेमजाम्बूनदचक्रवाLअम् ।महार्ह मुक्तामणिभूषितान्तम् ।परार्थ्यकालागुरुचन्दनाक्तं ।स रावणान्तःपुरमाविवेश ॥५-४-२९॥
verses.transliteration: sahemajāmbūnadacakravāLam ।mahārha muktāmaṇibhūṣitāntam ।parārthyakālāgurucandanāktaṁ ।sa rāvaṇāntaḥpuramāviveśa ॥5-4-29॥

translations.english: Hanuman entered the harem of Ravana surrounded by walls of gold inlaid with precious pearls and other gems and sprinkled with excellent black agaru and sandal water. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुर्थस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fourth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: ॥ इति रामायने सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुर्थः सर्गः ॥
verses.transliteration: ॥ iti rāmāyane sundarakāṇḍe caturthaḥ sargaḥ ॥

translations.hindi: इति चतुर्थः सग: ।। रावण के भवन का परकोटा विशुद्ध उत्तम सुवणं का बना हुमा था प्रोर उसमें यथास्थान बड़े-बड़े मूल्यवान मोती श्रौर मणियों के नग जडे हुए थे । रावण का अन्तःपुर सदा चन्दन, गुग्गुल भ्रादि सुगन्धित द्रव्यो से सुवासित रहता था । एसे राजभवन में हनुमानजी ने प्रवेश किया
